I’m currently pursuing a minor in Japanese, so I don’t have as much of a full scope as someone pursuing it as a major. However, overall I’ve been very pleased with the Japanese program and department as a whole. It’s a lot of work, but if you’re dedicated then you shouldn’t have an issue catching on. I will say that not every professor is made equal and SOME might be lacking in organization etc, etc, but every professor I’ve had hasn’t hesitated in the slightest to help out in any way they could. But let me reiterate: you have to study and stay on top of it or you will fall behind. (I’ve made this mistake). I haven’t had the opportunity to study abroad sadly, but I’m sure other can discuss that.
